items.title: 8-bit horror Tenebris Somnia mixes weird live-action horror with a retro 2D adventure to impressive and unsettling effect
items.summary: I've been captivated by the idea of wrong-footing an audience ever since playing Faith: The Unholy Trinity . That game presents like an 8-bit horror, then proceeds to bend the rules of what an 8-bit game can do - or perhaps what you remember they could do - in order to surprise and scare you. Tenebris Somnia is very similar. Indeed, it's executive produced by the developer of Faith, Airdorf Games, so the connection runs even deeper. Tenebris Somnia utilises the same retro aesthetic with its grinding chiptune music, its pixelated graphics, and old-school presentation. But the difference is it takes the rule-bending a step further, essentially welding two very different experiences together: a retro-styled 2D adventure and a full-on live-action film. items.title: Russia Places Apple on State Surveillance Registry
items.summary: Apple faces Russian data retention and disclosure requirements after being added to the country's state surveillance registry, Bloomberg reports. Russia's communications regulator, Roskomnadzor, listed Apple and Microsoft on October 2 as "organizers of information dissemination," a classification that carries obligations to preserve communications and make data available to Russian security agencies. Those obligations cover correspondence and messages containing audio or video. Companies must also keep information identifying users and recording the transmission of their communications within Russia for three years. Businesses that fail to meet the requirements risk fines and, ultimately, restrictions on their services. La startup californiana Tau Robotics ha aperto le prenotazioni per un servizio di pulizie ricorrenti, con interventi fino a tre ore. Il servizio, inizialmente disponibile su invito a San Francisco, utilizza robot umanoidi basati sulla piattaforma Unitree G1: possono aspirare, lavare i pavimenti, pulire le superfici e, con il supporto dell’operatore, affrontare attività più complesse come caricare la lavastoviglie, rifare i letti e pulire i sanitari.
